notes: Finishes the Sign out button that 1.0.8.2 shipped half of. It stopped the fleet and forgot the session correctly, then closed Apex and stopped there -- so signing in as anyone else meant going to find the shortcut again, which is the step the button existed to remove. Apex now starts itself back up at the sign-in screen. It waits for the old process to exit first, because Apex holds a single-instance lock until it does and a copy started any sooner would refuse itself with "Apex is already open" -- which would look exactly like sign out being broken. Take this one if you took 1.0.8.2.
